description: This file contains unit tests for the AbstractCommand class within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.base package, specifically testing behavior related to handling DittoHeaders and command responses.

classes.name: AbstractCommandTest
classes.description: Contains unit tests verifying behavior of AbstractCommand, especially related to response requirement handling.

classes.name: DummyQueryCommand
classes.description: A private static subclass of AbstractCommand used in tests to simulate command behavior.

methods.name: ensureThatQueryCommandWithResponseRequiredFalseThrowsException
methods.description: Tests that creating a query command with responseRequired set to false throws a CommandHeaderInvalidException.

methods.name: ensureThatQueryCommandWithResponseRequiredTrueSucceeds
methods.description: Tests that creating a query command with responseRequired set to true successfully creates the command.

methods.name: DummyQueryCommand's constructor
methods.description: Initializes a DummyQueryCommand with type and headers.

methods.name: DummyQueryCommand.getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer as the resource path.

methods.name: DummyQueryCommand.getResourceType
methods.description: Returns a fixed resource type string.

methods.name: DummyQueryCommand.getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns a string prefix for the command type.

methods.name: DummyQueryCommand.getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, in this case QUERY.

methods.name: DummyQueryCommand.setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the command; in this stub, it simply returns the current instance.

methods.name: DummyQueryCommand.appendPayload
methods.description: A no-op method intended to append command payload details to JSON, not utilized in tests.
